ozet: The journey to Yathrib and Amina's death at al-Abwa; Umm Ayman; the care of his grandfather 'Abd al-Muttalib and his death; the charge to Abu Talib.

b05-s01: The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) grew up well under Allah's protection, beside his mother Amina and his grandfather 'Abd al-Muttalib.
After returning from his wet nurse, he stayed with his mother for a while.
b05-s02: When the Prophet was six years old, his mother took him to Yathrib.
The aim was to visit the Banu al-Najjar. Salma, the mother of 'Abd al-Muttalib, came from this tribe; so the Banu al-Najjar were counted as the family's maternal uncles.
Umm Ayman, who served in their home, was with them on the journey. Amina also wished to visit 'Abdullah's grave in Yathrib.
b05-s03: They stayed in Yathrib for about a month.
b05-s04: On the way back to Mecca, Amina died at al-Abwa, between Mecca and Yathrib, and was buried there.
Al-Abwa lay about one hundred and ninety kilometres from Yathrib.
b05-s05: After his mother's death, Umm Ayman brought the six-year-old Prophet to Mecca and handed him over to his grandfather 'Abd al-Muttalib.
Umm Ayman was of Abyssinian origin and was the Prophet's nurse; she went on caring for him until he grew up.
The Messenger of Allah would say of her: «She is my mother after my mother.»
b05-s06: Years later the Messenger of Allah visited his mother's grave at al-Abwa; he wept, and those with him wept too.
According to the reports, this visit took place in the sixth year after the Hijra.
b05-s07: A mat used to be spread for 'Abd al-Muttalib in the shade of the Ka'ba.
His sons would sit around the mat; out of respect for him, none of them would sit on it.
b05-s08: The Prophet would come and sit on that mat. When his uncles took hold of him to pull him back, 'Abd al-Muttalib would say: «Leave my son alone! By Allah, he has a great future.»
Then he would seat him beside him, stroke his back, and be pleased with what he did.
'Abd al-Muttalib gave his grandson the care he needed.
b05-s09: When the Prophet was eight years old, 'Abd al-Muttalib died.
b05-s10: Before he died, 'Abd al-Muttalib had entrusted the care of his grandson to his son Abu Talib.
For Abu Talib and the Prophet's father 'Abdullah shared not only a father but also a mother.
From now on the Prophet was with his uncle Abu Talib.
